say:1:1730159301:1.text: I knew he was still alive! He showed up just in time and joined forces with Magister Merlin to crush Orion's conspiracy!
say:1:1730159301:1.source_cn: 我就知道他没有死！他在危机时刻现身，和大魔法师梅林携手...
say:1:1730159301:1.male: I knew he was still alive! He showed up just in time and joined forces with Magister Merlin to crush Orion's conspiracy!
say:1:1730159301:1.female: I knew he was still alive! He showed up just in time and joined forces with Magister Merlin to crush Orion's conspiracy!

say:2:1730159302:1.text: But he quietly left once the crisis was resolved.
say:2:1730159302:1.source_cn: 不过阴谋消散之后，他也悄然离开。
say:2:1730159302:1.male: But he quietly left once the crisis was resolved.
say:2:1730159302:1.female: But he quietly left once the crisis was resolved.

say:3:1730159303:1.text: Remember that little fox that used to hang around the plaza? It's gone too...
say:3:1730159303:1.source_cn: 他就和之前那只喜欢在广场附近溜达的小狐狸一样，不知道去...
say:3:1730159303:1.male: Remember that little fox that used to hang around the plaza? It's gone too...
say:3:1730159303:1.female: Remember that little fox that used to hang around the plaza? It's gone too...
